scope: measurement only; all seasons already seen; no mechanism/card/calibration changes
primary: player offensive rebound linked to missed field goal; FT/team rebounds excluded and counted separately

classification.firstOutcome: first subsequent same-team FG, turnover, regular FT or nontechnical defensive foul; opposing offensive event/defensive rebound ends as lost; period boundary ends as periodEnd
classification.immediateProxy: next outcome FG by same rebounder, zone short, elapsed game-clock seconds <=3
classification.otherShot: all other first FG; no assertion of adequate space
classification.officialPutback: real next FG descriptor/subType contains putback or tip; separate label not equivalent to timing proxy
classification.latency: period game-clock difference, excludes stopped wall time; timeout/substitution/violation interruption flagged
classification.points: points on first FG only; FT yield and full second-chance PPP not estimated
classification.invalid: missing/mismatched/nonmiss FG reference; negative time; no next event marked unknown; technical fouls ignored

simulation: frozen allocation candidate; three diagnostic seeds; nonrandom emit observer, full stats parity against existing allocation runs
aggregation: season pooled counts, four-season equal weight rates; descriptive only, no accuracy/adoption claim
uncertainty: game-cluster bootstrap real, seed+game hierarchical simulated, 20000 draws of per-season means with normal standard error approximation for descriptive gap; not adoption criterion
limits: short zone includes entire paint in both definitions; explicit tip/putback label separate
first-outcome metrics not full possession PPP
